description: Get live quotes for swapping one asset to another (cross-chain or same-chain). Returns routes ranked by amount received, each with a quoteToken, the executing protocol, expectedReceive, minimumReceived and estimated time. All fees (network, protocol and platform) are included.

buyAssetId.description: Asset to receive, e.g. "ethereum-eth". From list_assets.

providers.description: Optional: only return routes from these provider ids, e.g. ["NEAR", "FLASHNET"]. From list_providers.

sellAmount.description: Amount to send as a decimal string in the sell asset's units, e.g. "0.05".

sellAssetId.description: Asset to send, e.g. "bitcoin-btc". From list_assets.

name: get_quote
title: Get cross-chain swap quotes
